Adults presenting with suspected intracranial gliomas (including glioblastoma), cerebral metastasis, meningiomas, acoustic neuromas, and pituitary adenomas, who are surgical candidates

candidate_evidence.quote: At this point 5 mg/kg of fluorescein will be administered intravenously by an anesthesia provider over one minute.

The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the CONVIVO confocal endomicroscope in discriminating between normal and abnormal tissue in vivo during brain tumor surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Adults presenting with suspected intracranial gliomas (including glioblastoma), cerebral metastasis, meningiomas, acoustic neuromas, and pituitary adenomas, who are surgical candidates

role_evidence.quote: At this point 5 mg/kg of fluorescein will be administered intravenously by an anesthesia provider over one minute.
The images acquired with the CONVIVO system following administration of fluorescein will be compared to conventional histologic specimens from corresponding biopsies.

agents.drug_class_hint: fluorescent contrast agent (fluorescein sodium) for confocal endomicroscopy imaging

coder_notes: Device diagnostic study (CONVIVO confocal endomicroscope), Phase NA. Fluorescein is not a separately registered intervention but is given to every patient in the CONVIVO arm as an imaging agent; listed as diagnostic_agent. 5-ALA mentioned only conditionally in an outcome (if the participant has also received it); not listed. Multi-tumour brain population (glioma incl. glioblastoma, metastasis, meningioma, schwannoma, pituitary); coded basket_gbm_eligible, alternative mixed_glioma_gbm_named; both include. Second arm 'Conventional histologic evaluation' is the histology reference standard on the same tissue, not a control treatment arm, so control_arm_from_other_arms coded no. Treatment setting not stated (surgical candidates with suspected tumours).
